## Pilot Methods

```{r, include=FALSE}
library("here")       # file logistics
library("tidyverse")  # code logistics
library("gt")         # rendering tables
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# read in pilot data
data_path <- here("_data", "_participant_scores", "wave_2")

# read in data
pilot_2_dfs <- readRDS(here(data_path, "pilot_2_dfs.RDS"))

# rename ethnicity column 
pilot_2_dfs[['speeches2']] <- pilot_2_dfs[['speeches2']] |> 
  rename(Ethnicity = `Ethnicity simplified`)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# format pilot data

# subset each df
pilot_2_demog_dfs <- lapply(pilot_2_dfs, function(df){
  df <- df |> 
    select(participant_ID, Age, Sex, `Ethnicity`) |> 
    unique()})

#re-add spectrum to speeches2 df
pilot_2_demog_dfs[['speeches2']] <- merge(
  
  pilot_2_demog_dfs[['speeches2']],
  
  pilot_2_dfs[['speeches2']] |> 
    select(participant_ID, `Political spectrum (us)`) |> 
    unique(), 
  
  by = "participant_ID", all.x=T)

rm(pilot_2_dfs)


# convert age to numeric
pilot_2_demog_dfs <- lapply(pilot_2_demog_dfs, 
                            function(df){df|>mutate(Age = as.numeric(Age))})

# recode Asian ethnicity
pilot_2_demog_dfs[["lyrics"]] <- pilot_2_demog_dfs[["lyrics"]] |> 
  mutate(Ethnicity = case_when(
    Ethnicity == "East Asian" | Ethnicity == "South East Asian" | Ethnicity == "South Asian" ~ "Asian", 
    .default = Ethnicity))

pilot_2_demog_dfs[["speeches1"]]<- pilot_2_demog_dfs[["speeches1"]] |> 
  mutate(Ethnicity = case_when(
    Ethnicity == "East Asian" | Ethnicity == "South East Asian" | Ethnicity == "South Asian" ~ "Asian", 
    .default = Ethnicity))

# Remove expired data
pilot_2_demog_dfs[["speeches2"]] <- pilot_2_demog_dfs[["speeches2"]] |> mutate(Ethnicity = case_when(
  Ethnicity == "DATA_EXPIRED" ~ NA, 
  .default = Ethnicity
))

# study labels
pilot_labels <- c(
  lyrics     = "Pilot 1 (Lyrics)",
  speeches1  = "Pilot 2 (Speeches: Ethnicity)",
  speeches2  = "Pilot 3 (Speeches: Political)")

# details for all studies
pilot_2_demog_df <- pilot_2_demog_dfs |> bind_rows(.id = "study")
```

The total participant pool consisted of `r nrow(pilot_2_demog_df)` participants 
(`r round(mean(pilot_2_demog_df$Sex == "Female", na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)`% female, 
$M_{\text{age}} = `r round(mean(pilot_2_demog_df$Age, na.rm = TRUE), 1)`$ years, 
$SD_{\text{age}} = `r round(sd(pilot_2_demog_df$Age, na.rm = TRUE), 1)`$) 
(see Table 1).


```{r, include=FALSE}
# summary functions
summarize_demographics <- function(df, study_name) {
  df %>%
    summarise(
      Study   = study_name,
      N       = n(),
      Age_M   = mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
      Age_SD  = sd(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
      Age_Min  = min(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
      Age_Max  = max(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
      Female_p  = mean(Sex == "Female", na.rm = TRUE) * 100) %>%
  mutate(
    `Age M (SD)` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", Age_M, Age_SD),
    `Age range`  = sprintf("%d–%d", round(Age_Min), round(Age_Max)),
    `% Female`   = round(Female_p, 1)) %>%
  select(Study, N, `Age M (SD)`, `Age range`, `% Female`)
}

summarize_ethnicity <- function(df, study_name) {
  df %>%
    count(Ethnicity) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = 100 * n / sum(n),
      value = paste0(n, " (", round(pct, 1), "%)")
    ) %>%
    select(Ethnicity, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Ethnicity, values_from = value) %>%
    mutate(Study = study_name, .before = 1)
}


summarize_spectrum <- function(df, study_name) {
  df %>%
    count(`Political spectrum (us)`) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = 100 * n / sum(n),
      value = paste0(n, " (", round(pct, 1), "%)")
    ) %>%
    select(`Political spectrum (us)`, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = `Political spectrum (us)`, values_from = value) %>%
    mutate(Study = study_name, .before = 1)
}
```

```{r pilot_demogs}
# demographics table
table <- imap_dfr(
  pilot_2_demog_dfs,
  ~ summarize_demographics(.x, pilot_labels[[.y]] %||% .y))

table <- table %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_align(align = "left",  columns = c(Study)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(N, `% Female`, `Age range`, `Age M (SD)`)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = `% Female`, decimals = 1) 

table

gtsave(table, here("tables", "pilot_demographics.tex"))

rm(table)
```


```{r}
table <- imap_dfr(
  pilot_2_demog_dfs[1:2], 
  ~ summarize_ethnicity(.x, pilot_labels[[.y]] %||% .y)) 

table <- table |>
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    `Black/African American` = html("Black/<br>African American"),
    `Latino/Hispanic`        = html("Latino/<br>Hispanic"),
    Asian                    = "Asian",
    White                    = "White") |>
  
  fmt_number(columns = -Study, decimals = 1) %>%
  
  cols_align(align = "center", 
             columns = c(Asian, `Black/African American`, 
                         `Latino/Hispanic`, White))

table

gtsave(table, here("tables", "pilot_ethnicity.tex"))

rm(table)
```

```{r}
table <- pilot_spectrum_tbl <- imap_dfr(
  pilot_2_demog_dfs["speeches2"],
  ~ summarize_spectrum(.x, pilot_labels[[.y]] %||% .y))

table <- pilot_spectrum_tbl |>
  gt() %>%
  
  fmt_number(
    columns = -Study, 
    decimals = 1) %>%
  
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(Conservative, Liberal, Moderate)) 

table

gtsave(table, here("tables", "pilot_political_leaning.tex"))

rm(table)
```
